s.plain: Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house next to ours.
s.kana: Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house next to ours.

t: Her name is Mrs. Green, and she is eighty years old.
s.plain: Her name is Mrs. Green, and she is eighty years old.
s.kana: Her name is Mrs. Green, and she is eighty years old.

paragraphs.zh: 上個月，有一位新鄰居搬進了我們隔壁的房子。她叫格林太太，今年八十歲。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 上个月，有一位新邻居搬进了我们隔壁的房子。她叫格林太太，今年八十岁。

s.plain: Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat.
s.kana: Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat.

s.plain: She has a beautiful garden with lots of flowers.
s.kana: She has a beautiful garden with lots of flowers.

s.plain: Every morning, she waters them.
s.kana: Every morning, she waters them.

paragraphs.zh: 格林太太一個人和她的貓住。她有一座開滿花的漂亮花園。她每天早上都會澆花。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 格林太太一个人和她的猫住。她有一座开满花的漂亮花园。她每天早上都会浇花。

t: On Saturday, I saw her with three
s.plain: On Saturday, I saw her with three heavy bags from the store.
s.kana: On Saturday, I saw her with three heavy bags from the store.

s.plain: I helped her carry them into her kitchen.
s.kana: I helped her carry them into her kitchen.

paragraphs.zh: 星期六，我看到她提著三個從商店買回來的重袋子。我幫她把袋子提進廚房。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 星期六，我看到她提着三个从商店买回来的重袋子。我帮她把袋子提进厨房。

t: The next day, she brought us some cookies.
s.plain: The next day, she brought us some cookies.
s.kana: The next day, she brought us some cookies.

s.plain: They were delicious!
s.kana: They were delicious!

t: Now we often talk over the fence.
s.plain: Now we often talk over the fence.
s.kana: Now we often talk over the fence.

paragraphs.zh: 隔天，她送了一些餅乾給我們。好好吃！現在我們常常隔著圍籬聊天。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 隔天，她送了一些饼干给我们。好好吃！现在我们常常隔着围篱聊天。

glossary.en: a person who lives next to you
to go to live in a new place
a place with flowers and plants
to hold something and take it somewhere

q: When did Mrs. Green move in?
mcq.zh: 「Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house」：上個月。
mcq.en: “Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house」：上个月。

q: Who lives with Mrs. Green?
mcq.zh: 「Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat」：她的貓。
mcq.en: “Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat」：她的猫。

q: What does she do every morning?
mcq.zh: 「Every morning, she waters them」：澆花。
mcq.en: “Every morning, she waters them” — the flowers.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Every morning, she waters them」：浇花。

q: How did the writer help her?
options: By driving her to the store
mcq.zh: 「I helped her carry them into her kitchen」：幫她提袋子。
mcq.en: “I helped her carry them into her kitchen.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I helped her carry them into her kitchen」：帮她提袋子。

q: What did Mrs. Green bring the next day?
mcq.zh: 「she brought us some cookies」：餅乾。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「she brought us some cookies」：饼干。

s: Mrs. Green is eighty years old.
tf.zh: ○：「she is eighty years old」。
tf.en: True: she is eighty years old.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「she is eighty years old」。

s: Her garden has no flowers.
tf.zh: ×：「a beautiful garden with lots of flowers」，有很多花。
tf.en: False: a beautiful garden with lots of flowers.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「a beautiful garden with lots of flowers」，有很多花。

s: Now they often talk over the fence.
tf.zh: ○：「Now we often talk over the fence」。
tf.en: True: Now we often talk over the fence.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「Now we often talk over the fence」。

s.plain: Sunday was my dad's birthday.
s.kana: Sunday was my dad's birthday.

t: My sister and I got up
s.plain: My sister and I got up early to make him breakfast.
s.kana: My sister and I got up early to make him breakfast.

paragraphs.zh: 星期天是爸爸的生日。我和妹妹很早起床幫他做早餐。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 星期天是爸爸的生日。我和妹妹很早起床帮他做早餐。

s.plain: We decided to make pancakes.
s.kana: We decided to make pancakes.

t: flour, milk and eggs in a big
s.plain: I mixed flour, milk and eggs in a big bowl.
s.kana: I mixed flour, milk and eggs in a big bowl.

s.plain: My sister cut some strawberries.
s.kana: My sister cut some strawberries.

paragraphs.zh: 我們決定做鬆餅。我在一個大碗裡把麵粉、牛奶和雞蛋攪拌在一起。妹妹切了一些草莓。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们决定做松饼。我在一个大碗里把面粉、牛奶和鸡蛋搅拌在一起。妹妹切了一些草莓。

s.plain: The first pancake was burned, and the kitchen was a mess.
s.kana: The first pancake was burned, and the kitchen was a mess.

t: But the other pancakes were perfect.
s.plain: But the other pancakes were perfect.
s.kana: But the other pancakes were perfect.

paragraphs.zh: 第一片鬆餅燒焦了，廚房也亂七八糟。但是其他的鬆餅都很完美。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 第一片松饼烧焦了，厨房也乱七八糟。但是其他的松饼都很完美。

t: We put them on a plate with the strawberries and a candle.
s.plain: We put them on a plate with the strawberries and a candle.
s.kana: We put them on a plate with the strawberries and a candle.

t: When Dad saw it, he laughed and gave us a big
s.plain: When Dad saw it, he laughed and gave us a big hug.
s.kana: When Dad saw it, he laughed and gave us a big hug.

paragraphs.zh: 我們把鬆餅、草莓和一根蠟燭放在盤子上。爸爸看到的時候笑了，給了我們一個大大的擁抱。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们把松饼、草莓和一根蜡烛放在盘子上。爸爸看到的时候笑了，给了我们一个大大的拥抱。

glossary.en: to put things together and stir
to make into pieces with a knife

q: Whose birthday was it?
mcq.zh: 「Sunday was my dad's birthday」：爸爸的生日。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Sunday was my dad's birthday」：爸爸的生日。

q: What did they make?
mcq.zh: 「We decided to make pancakes」：鬆餅。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「We decided to make pancakes」：松饼。

q: What did the sister do?
mcq.zh: 「My sister cut some strawberries」：切草莓。攪拌的是「我」。
mcq.en: “My sister cut some strawberries.” The writer did the mixing.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「My sister cut some strawberries」：切草莓。搅拌的是「我」。

q: What was wrong with the first pancake?
mcq.zh: 「The first pancake was burned」：燒焦了。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「The first pancake was burned」：烧焦了。

q: What did Dad do when he saw it?
mcq.zh: 「he laughed and gave us a big hug」：笑著擁抱他們。
mcq.en: “he laughed and gave us a big hug.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「he laughed and gave us a big hug」：笑着拥抱他们。

s: They got up early.
tf.zh: ○：「My sister and I got up early」。
tf.en: True: My sister and I got up early.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「My sister and I got up early」。

s: All the pancakes were burned.
tf.zh: ×：只有第一片燒焦，「the other pancakes were perfect」。
tf.en: False: only the first; the other pancakes were perfect.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：只有第一片烧焦，「the other pancakes were perfect」。

s: There was a candle on the plate.
tf.zh: ○：「with the strawberries and a candle」。
tf.en: True: with the strawberries and a candle.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「with the strawberries and a candle」。

t: Last summer, my family went camping by a
s.plain: Last summer, my family went camping by a lake in the mountains.
s.kana: Last summer, my family went camping by a lake in the mountains.

s.plain: We drove there for three hours.
s.kana: We drove there for three hours.

paragraphs.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家去山裡的一座湖邊露營。我們開了三個小時的車。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 去年夏天，我们全家去山里的一座湖边露营。我们开了三个小时的车。

s.plain: First, my dad and I put up the tent.
s.kana: First, my dad and I put up the tent.

t: It was hard, but we did it in thirty minutes.
s.plain: It was hard, but we did it in thirty minutes.
s.kana: It was hard, but we did it in thirty minutes.

t: Then we went swimming in the
s.plain: Then we went swimming in the lake.
s.kana: Then we went swimming in the lake.

s.plain: The water was very cold!
s.kana: The water was very cold!

paragraphs.zh: 首先，我和爸爸把帳篷搭起來。很難，但是我們三十分鐘就搭好了。然後我們去湖裡游泳。湖水好冰！
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 首先，我和爸爸把帐篷搭起来。很难，但是我们三十分钟就搭好了。然后我们去湖里游泳。湖水好冰！

s.plain: At night, we made a fire and cooked hot dogs.
s.kana: At night, we made a fire and cooked hot dogs.

s.plain: There were thousands of stars in the sky.
s.kana: There were thousands of stars in the sky.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上我們生了火，煮熱狗。天上有成千上萬顆星星。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 晚上我们生了火，煮热狗。天上有成千上万颗星星。

s.plain: The only problem was the mosquitoes.
s.kana: The only problem was the mosquitoes.

t: In the morning, my legs were covered in bites.
s.plain: In the morning, my legs were covered in bites.
s.kana: In the morning, my legs were covered in bites.

paragraphs.zh: 唯一的問題是蚊子。早上起來，我的腿上全是蚊子咬的包。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 唯一的问题是蚊子。早上起来，我的腿上全是蚊子咬的包。

glossary.en: a large area of water with land around it
a shelter you sleep in when camping
flames that give heat and light
something that is difficult or bad

q: Where did the family go camping?
options: By a lake in the mountains
In a forest near their house
mcq.zh: 「camping by a lake in the mountains」：山裡的湖邊。
mcq.en: “camping by a lake in the mountains.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「camping by a lake in the mountains」：山里的湖边。

q: How long did they drive?
mcq.zh: 「We drove there for three hours」：三小時。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「We drove there for three hours」：三小时。

q: How long did it take to put up the tent?
mcq.zh: 「we did it in thirty minutes」：三十分鐘。三小時是開車的時間。
mcq.en: “we did it in thirty minutes.” Three hours was the drive.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「we did it in thirty minutes」：三十分钟。三小时是开车的时间。

q: What did they cook at night?
mcq.zh: 「we made a fire and cooked hot dogs」：熱狗。
mcq.en: “we made a fire and cooked hot dogs.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「we made a fire and cooked hot dogs」：热狗。

q: What was the only problem?
mcq.zh: 「The only problem was the mosquitoes」：蚊子。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「The only problem was the mosquitoes」：蚊子。

s: The water in the lake was warm.
tf.zh: ×：「The water was very cold!」，很冰。
tf.en: False: The water was very cold!
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「The water was very cold!」，很冰。

s: There were many stars in the sky.
tf.zh: ○：「There were thousands of stars in the sky」。
tf.en: True: There were thousands of stars in the sky.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「There were thousands of stars in the sky」。

s: The writer put up the tent with Mom.
tf.zh: ×：是「my dad and I」（和爸爸）搭的。
tf.en: False: it was my dad and I.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：是「my dad and I」（和爸爸）搭的。

t: On Saturday morning, the sky was blue and
s.plain: On Saturday morning, the sky was blue and sunny.
s.kana: On Saturday morning, the sky was blue and sunny.

t: My friends and I decided to have a
s.plain: My friends and I decided to have a picnic in the park.
s.kana: My friends and I decided to have a picnic in the park.

paragraphs.zh: 星期六早上，天空很藍，陽光很好。我和朋友們決定去公園野餐。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 星期六早上，天空很蓝，阳光很好。我和朋友们决定去公园野餐。

t: We brought sandwiches, fruit and lemonade.
s.plain: We brought sandwiches, fruit and lemonade.
s.kana: We brought sandwiches, fruit and lemonade.

s.plain: We sat on a blanket in the sun.
s.kana: We sat on a blanket in the sun.

paragraphs.zh: 我們帶了三明治、水果和檸檬汁。我們坐在陽光下的野餐墊上。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们带了三明治、水果和柠檬汁。我们坐在阳光下的野餐垫上。

t: came, and it started to rain.
s.plain: Suddenly, dark clouds came, and it started to rain.
s.kana: Suddenly, dark clouds came, and it started to rain.

t: We ran under a big tree and laughed.
s.plain: We ran under a big tree and laughed.
s.kana: We ran under a big tree and laughed.

s.plain: Our sandwiches were wet!
s.kana: Our sandwiches were wet!

paragraphs.zh: 突然烏雲飄來，開始下雨了。我們跑到一棵大樹下，一邊笑。我們的三明治都濕了！
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 突然乌云飘来，开始下雨了。我们跑到一棵大树下，一边笑。我们的三明治都湿了！

s.plain: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.
s.kana: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.

s.plain: Then we saw a beautiful rainbow over the park.
s.kana: Then we saw a beautiful rainbow over the park.

paragraphs.zh: 二十分鐘後，雨停了。然後我們看到公園上空出現一道美麗的彩虹。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 二十分钟后，雨停了。然后我们看到公园上空出现一道美丽的彩虹。

glossary.en: a white or grey shape in the sky
a curve of colors in the sky

q: What was the weather like in the morning?
mcq.zh: 「the sky was blue and sunny」：晴朗。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「the sky was blue and sunny」：晴朗。

q: Where did they have the picnic?
mcq.zh: 「a picnic in the park」：公園。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「a picnic in the park」：公园。

q: What did they not bring?
mcq.zh: 他們帶了三明治、水果和檸檬汁，沒有蛋糕。
mcq.en: They brought sandwiches, fruit and lemonade — no cake.
mcq.zh-Hans: 他们带了三明治、水果和柠檬汁，没有蛋糕。

q: Where did they go when it rained?
mcq.zh: 「We ran under a big tree」：大樹下。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「We ran under a big tree」：大树下。

q: What did they see after the rain?
mcq.zh: 「we saw a beautiful rainbow」：彩虹。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「we saw a beautiful rainbow」：彩虹。

s: It rained all day.
tf.zh: ×：「After twenty minutes, the rain stopped」，二十分鐘就停了。
tf.en: False: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「After twenty minutes, the rain stopped」，二十分钟就停了。

s: Their sandwiches got wet.
tf.zh: ○：「Our sandwiches were wet!」。
tf.en: True: Our sandwiches were wet!
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「Our sandwiches were wet!」。

s: The rain stopped after twenty minutes.
tf.zh: ○：「After twenty minutes, the rain stopped」。
tf.en: True: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「After twenty minutes, the rain stopped」。

t: On Saturday, our neighbors had a
s.plain: On Saturday, our neighbors had a garage sale.
s.kana: On Saturday, our neighbors had a garage sale.

t: They put old things on tables
s.plain: They put old things on tables in front of their house.
s.kana: They put old things on tables in front of their house.

paragraphs.zh: 星期六，我們的鄰居辦了一場車庫拍賣（在自家門口賣舊東西）。他們把舊東西放在家門前的桌子上。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 星期六，我们的邻居办了一场车库拍卖（在自家门口卖旧东西）。他们把旧东西放在家门前的桌子上。

s.plain: There were books, toys, clothes and a lamp.
s.kana: There were books, toys, clothes and a lamp.

s.plain: Everything was very cheap.
s.kana: Everything was very cheap.

paragraphs.zh: 有書、玩具、衣服和一盞檯燈。每樣東西都很便宜。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 有书、玩具、衣服和一盏台灯。每样东西都很便宜。

s.plain: I saw an old guitar.
s.kana: I saw an old guitar.

t: was twenty dollars, but I only had fifteen.
s.plain: The price was twenty dollars, but I only had fifteen.
s.kana: The price was twenty dollars, but I only had fifteen.

t: The man said, “OK, fifteen is fine.”
s.plain: The man said, “OK, fifteen is fine.”
s.kana: The man said, “OK, fifteen is fine.”

paragraphs.zh: 我看到一把舊吉他。價錢是二十元，可是我只有十五元。那位先生說：「好啊，十五元也可以。」
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我看到一把旧吉他。价钱是二十元，可是我只有十五元。那位先生说：「好啊，十五元也可以。」

t: I also bought two books for one dollar
s.plain: I also bought two books for one dollar each.
s.kana: I also bought two books for one dollar each.

t: to play the guitar every day.
s.plain: Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day.
s.kana: Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day.

paragraphs.zh: 我還買了兩本書，一本一元。現在我每天都在學彈吉他。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我还买了两本书，一本一元。现在我每天都在学弹吉他。

glossary.zh: 車庫拍賣（在家門口賣舊物）
glossary.en: a sale of old things at someone's home
glossary.zh-Hans: 车库拍卖（在家门口卖旧物）

glossary.en: to get to know how to do something

q: Who had the garage sale?
mcq.zh: 「our neighbors had a garage sale」：鄰居。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「our neighbors had a garage sale」：邻居。

q: Where were the old things?
options: On tables in front of the house
mcq.zh: 「on tables in front of their house」：家門前的桌子上。
mcq.en: “on tables in front of their house.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「on tables in front of their house」：家门前的桌子上。

q: What was the price of the guitar?
mcq.zh: 「The price was twenty dollars」：標價二十元。十五元是最後付的錢。
mcq.en: “The price was twenty dollars.” Fifteen is what he paid.
mcq.zh-Hans: 「The price was twenty dollars」：标价二十元。十五元是最后付的钱。

q: How much did the writer pay for the guitar?
mcq.zh: 「OK, fifteen is fine」：十五元。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「OK, fifteen is fine」：十五元。

q: What else did the writer buy?
mcq.zh: 「I also bought two books」：兩本書。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I also bought two books」：两本书。

s: Everything was very expensive.
tf.zh: ×：「Everything was very cheap」。
tf.en: False: Everything was very cheap.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「Everything was very cheap」。

s: Each book cost one dollar.
tf.zh: ○：「two books for one dollar each」。
tf.en: True: two books for one dollar each.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「two books for one dollar each」。

s: The writer is learning the guitar.
tf.zh: ○：「Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day」。
tf.en: True: Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day」。

s.plain: This month, our science teacher gave us a project.
s.kana: This month, our science teacher gave us a project.

t: We had to make something and
s.plain: We had to make something and explain it to the class.
s.kana: We had to make something and explain it to the class.

paragraphs.zh: 這個月，自然老師給了我們一份作業。我們要做出一樣東西，並向全班說明。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 这个月，自然老师给了我们一份作业。我们要做出一样东西，并向全班说明。

t: Kevin and I made a volcano.
s.plain: My partner Kevin and I made a volcano.
s.kana: My partner Kevin and I made a volcano.

s.plain: We used paper, glue and paint.
s.kana: We used paper, glue and paint.

paragraphs.zh: 我和搭檔凱文做了一座火山。我們用了紙、膠水和顏料。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我和搭档凯文做了一座火山。我们用了纸、胶水和颜料。

t: Inside the volcano, we put baking soda.
s.plain: Inside the volcano, we put baking soda.
s.kana: Inside the volcano, we put baking soda.

t: vinegar, red foam came out of the top!
s.plain: When we added vinegar, red foam came out of the top!
s.kana: When we added vinegar, red foam came out of the top!

s.plain: Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”
s.kana: Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”

paragraphs.zh: 我們在火山裡面放了小蘇打。加入醋的時候，紅色的泡沫從山頂冒了出來！全班都大叫：「哇！」
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们在火山里面放了小苏打。加入醋的时候，红色的泡沫从山顶冒了出来！全班都大叫：「哇！」

s.plain: We got second place.
s.kana: We got second place.

t: Our teacher said it was very creative.
s.plain: Our teacher said it was very creative.
s.kana: Our teacher said it was very creative.

paragraphs.zh: 我們得了第二名。老師說我們的作品很有創意。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我们得了第二名。老师说我们的作品很有创意。

glossary.en: a piece of planned school work

q: Who gave them the project?
mcq.zh: 「our science teacher gave us a project」：自然老師。
mcq.en: “our science teacher gave us a project.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「our science teacher gave us a project」：自然老师。

q: What did they make?
mcq.zh: 「Kevin and I made a volcano」：火山。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Kevin and I made a volcano」：火山。

q: What came out of the top?
mcq.zh: 「red foam came out of the top」：紅色泡沫。
mcq.en: “red foam came out of the top.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「red foam came out of the top」：红色泡沫。

q: What place did they get?
mcq.zh: 「We got second place」：第二名。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「We got second place」：第二名。

q: What did the teacher say?
mcq.zh: 「Our teacher said it was very creative」：很有創意。
mcq.en: “Our teacher said it was very creative.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「Our teacher said it was very creative」：很有创意。

s: They used paper, glue and paint.
tf.zh: ○：「We used paper, glue and paint」。
tf.en: True: We used paper, glue and paint.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「We used paper, glue and paint」。

s: They put vinegar inside the volcano first.
tf.zh: ×：先放的是「baking soda」（小蘇打），之後才加醋。
tf.en: False: baking soda went in first; the vinegar was added after.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：先放的是「baking soda」（小苏打），之后才加醋。

s: Nobody in the class was surprised.
tf.zh: ×：「Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”」。
tf.en: False: Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”」。

s.plain: Last winter, I flew to Seoul to visit my uncle.
s.kana: Last winter, I flew to Seoul to visit my uncle.

t: It was my first time on a plane.
s.plain: It was my first time on a plane.
s.kana: It was my first time on a plane.

paragraphs.zh: 去年冬天，我搭飛機去首爾看叔叔。那是我第一次坐飛機。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 去年冬天，我搭飞机去首尔看叔叔。那是我第一次坐飞机。

s.plain: At the airport, I was a little nervous.
s.kana: At the airport, I was a little nervous.

t: But the flight attendant was very kind and showed me my
s.plain: But the flight attendant was very kind and showed me my seat.
s.kana: But the flight attendant was very kind and showed me my seat.

s.plain: I had a window seat!
s.kana: I had a window seat!

paragraphs.zh: 在機場的時候我有點緊張。但是空服員很親切，帶我找到座位。我坐靠窗的位子！
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 在机场的时候我有点紧张。但是空服员很亲切，带我找到座位。我坐靠窗的位子！

s.plain: When the plane took off, my ears hurt a little.
s.kana: When the plane took off, my ears hurt a little.

t: Then I looked out of the window.
s.plain: Then I looked out of the window.
s.kana: Then I looked out of the window.

t: the clouds, and they looked like cotton.
s.plain: We were above the clouds, and they looked like cotton.
s.kana: We were above the clouds, and they looked like cotton.

paragraphs.zh: 飛機起飛的時候，我的耳朵有點痛。然後我看向窗外。我們在雲的上面，雲看起來像棉花一樣。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 飞机起飞的时候，我的耳朵有点痛。然后我看向窗外。我们在云的上面，云看起来像棉花一样。

s.plain: The flight took three hours.
s.kana: The flight took three hours.

t: was waiting for me at the
s.plain: My uncle was waiting for me at the airport with a big sign.
s.kana: My uncle was waiting for me at the airport with a big sign.

paragraphs.zh: 飛行花了三個小時。叔叔拿著一個大牌子在機場等我。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 飞行花了三个小时。叔叔拿着一个大牌子在机场等我。

glossary.en: a place where planes land and take off
a board with words on it

q: Where did the writer fly to?
mcq.zh: 「I flew to Seoul」：首爾。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I flew to Seoul」：首尔。

q: Who did the writer visit?
mcq.zh: 「to visit my uncle」：叔叔。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「to visit my uncle」：叔叔。

q: What kind of seat did the writer have?
mcq.zh: 「I had a window seat!」：靠窗的位子。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I had a window seat!」：靠窗的位子。

q: What happened when the plane took off?
options: The writer's ears hurt a little
mcq.zh: 「my ears hurt a little」：耳朵有點痛。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「my ears hurt a little」：耳朵有点痛。

q: How long was the flight?
mcq.zh: 「The flight took three hours」：三小時。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「The flight took three hours」：三小时。

s: The writer was on a plane for the first time.
tf.zh: ○：「It was my first time on a plane」。
tf.en: True: It was my first time on a plane.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「It was my first time on a plane」。

s: The clouds looked like cotton.
tf.zh: ○：「they looked like cotton」。
tf.en: True: they looked like cotton.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「they looked like cotton」。

s: Nobody was waiting at the airport.
tf.zh: ×：「My uncle was waiting for me at the airport」。
tf.en: False: My uncle was waiting for me at the airport.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「My uncle was waiting for me at the airport」。

s.plain: Yesterday was very hot.
s.kana: Yesterday was very hot.

t: After lunch, I ate three ice creams with my friends.
s.plain: After lunch, I ate three ice creams with my friends.
s.kana: After lunch, I ate three ice creams with my friends.

paragraphs.zh: 昨天很熱。午餐後，我和朋友們吃了三支冰淇淋。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 昨天很热。午餐后，我和朋友们吃了三支冰淇淋。

s.plain: During math class, my stomach started to hurt.
s.kana: During math class, my stomach started to hurt.

t: I told my teacher, and she
s.plain: I told my teacher, and she sent me to the school nurse.
s.kana: I told my teacher, and she sent me to the school nurse.

paragraphs.zh: 上數學課的時候，我的肚子開始痛。我告訴老師，她叫我去找學校護士。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 上数学课的时候，我的肚子开始痛。我告诉老师，她叫我去找学校护士。

t: asked me, “What did you eat today?”
s.plain: The nurse asked me, “What did you eat today?”
s.kana: The nurse asked me, “What did you eat today?”

t: and said, “That's too much ice cream!”
s.plain: When I told her, she smiled and said, “That's too much ice cream!”
s.kana: When I told her, she smiled and said, “That's too much ice cream!”

paragraphs.zh: 護士問我：「你今天吃了什麼？」我告訴她以後，她笑著說：「冰淇淋吃太多了！」
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 护士问我：「你今天吃了什么？」我告诉她以后，她笑着说：「冰淇淋吃太多了！」

t: She gave me a glass of
s.plain: She gave me a glass of warm water and let me rest for an hour.
s.kana: She gave me a glass of warm water and let me rest for an hour.

t: Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream.
s.plain: Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream.
s.kana: Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream.

paragraphs.zh: 她給我一杯溫水，讓我休息了一個小時。下次我只吃一支冰淇淋就好。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 她给我一杯温水，让我休息了一个小时。下次我只吃一支冰淇淋就好。

glossary.en: the part of your body where food goes
to tell someone to go somewhere
a person who looks after sick people

q: How many ice creams did the writer eat?
mcq.zh: 「I ate three ice creams」：三支。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「I ate three ice creams」：三支。

q: When did the writer's stomach start to hurt?
mcq.zh: 「During math class, my stomach started to hurt」：數學課。
mcq.en: “During math class, my stomach started to hurt.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「During math class, my stomach started to hurt」：数学课。

q: Who did the teacher send the writer to?
mcq.zh: 「she sent me to the school nurse」：學校護士。
mcq.en: “she sent me to the school nurse.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「she sent me to the school nurse」：学校护士。

q: What did the nurse give the writer?
mcq.zh: 「She gave me a glass of warm water」：一杯溫水。
mcq.en: “She gave me a glass of warm water.”
mcq.zh-Hans: 「She gave me a glass of warm water」：一杯温水。

q: How long did the writer rest?
mcq.zh: 「let me rest for an hour」：一小時。
mcq.zh-Hans: 「let me rest for an hour」：一小时。

s: It was cold yesterday.
tf.zh: ×：「Yesterday was very hot」。
tf.en: False: Yesterday was very hot.
tf.zh-Hans: ×：「Yesterday was very hot」。

s: The nurse smiled.
tf.zh: ○：「she smiled and said…」。
tf.en: True: she smiled and said…
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「she smiled and said…」。

s: Next time, the writer will eat only one ice cream.
tf.zh: ○：「Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream」。
tf.en: True: Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream.
tf.zh-Hans: ○：「Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream」。
